problems: Entries that reach across the window boundary: rulings/0 (Hejaz) to 1810; rulings/1 (Illyrian Provinces against the Military Frontier) to 1813, 55 cell-years in 1810 in the p1810-p1819 packet; keyframe_overrides/0 (kingdom-of-sardinia_1800 now ends in 1801, so the island-only keyframe is alone to 1813); keyframe_overrides/2 (colonial-brazil_1801 spans 1801-1815); keyframe_overrides/6 (russian-empire_1809 spans 1809-1810, so russian-empire_1811, _1812 and _1814 of the next window may release the Tarnopol circle again; the p1810 agent should add it there).

New keyframe ids 1800b, 1802b and 1804b (spanish-empire, french-consulate, first-french-empire) rely on the compiler unioning the keyframes alive in a year; they end in 1800, 1804 and 1808, and spanish-empire/ledger/74-76 returns Santo Domingo to Spain in 1809.

Systematic: dossiers whose keyframe text says 'for 18xx only' but which keep a longer Cliopatria span union with later keyframes; 35 overlapping pairs touch 1800-1809 (nine slugs listed under issues). A validator warning for keyframe overlaps would catch them for every window.
Unresolved region: kingdom-of-tahiti ledger/1 (1808, Moorea) is unknown to the gazetteer, so the loss moves nothing; a patch cannot change an existing event, and I opened no page on it.
hierarchy: no wrong row found in the 1800-1809 rows checked (Coorg as vassal of the East India Company from 1790 and Tripura from 1809 are unverified).
Trial result: end anchor p1810 changes owner or status in 1,861 cells (against the published draft; includes dossier edits since 1 Nov 20:39 such as Denmark).
